question: Where was India House founded in the UK?
solution:
The correct answer is **__London__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shyamji Krishna Varma** founded the India House in 1905.
 
• **India House** in **London **was founded by **Shyamji Krishna Verma**, an Indian revolutionary fighter, lawyer, and journalist.
 
• The establishment served as a hub for Indian students in England who were pursuing higher education. It used to offer scholarships to these students.
 
• The organization sought to promote nationalist views among the students.
 
• It formed a group to fight the British rule from their own soil. **Madam Cama** was part of this group and played a key role as a socialist and a revolutionary.
 
• He represented India at the Berlin Congress of Orientalists in 1881.
 
• He worked for a number of Indian princely states in India as the Divan.
 
• He also founded the “The Indian Sociologist”.
 
• On 04 October 1989, The India Post issued a postal stamp on Shyamji Krishna Varma.
 
• He founded the Indian Home Rule Society also.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Taraknath Das was instrumental in the founding of the Ghadar Party along with Lala Hardayal.
 
• Ras Behari Bose was an Indian revolutionary. He was associated with landmark events such as
 
 
• Assassination attempt of lord Hardinge in 1912 in Delhi.
 
• Foundation of Indian Independence League at Tokyo in 1942.
 
• He was instrumental in the formation of the INA.
